items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Who did he have on trumpet then? Joe Lied? No.

ctx.x: No, Tony O'Sullivan was still here then I know. No, he's joining him now. The band is supposed to be very well from people like a very good band.
Who did he have on trumpet then? Joe Lied? No.
He was a fellow from out of town. He was not from London. He plays now with Jim Young's band. He was another guy who couldn't hold the band together. It was like Keith Smith. Mike? No, Jim Young.
